name: What are the benefits of converting a tub to a shower?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of converting a tub to a shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting a tub to a shower offers several advantages. It can significantly improve bathroom accessibility, especially for individuals with mobility challenges, making it safer to enter and exit. A walk-in shower often creates a more open and modern aesthetic, potentially increasing your home's appeal. Additionally, showers can be more water-efficient than baths, and easier to clean depending on the design and materials chosen.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include improved accessibility, a modern bathroom aesthetic, and potentially better water efficiency. It can also make cleaning easier.
